visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor space with a textured, golden mosaic wall in the background. A man with dark hair, wearing a crisp white button-down shirt, sits on the left, gesturing with his hand near his chin while his mouth moves as if speaking. Next to him is a woman with short, brown hair, wearing dark sunglasses and a beige blazer over a patterned shirt; she smiles and looks toward the camera. A glass table in front of them is covered with numerous small, silver-packaged product samples. (2) The camera remains static as the man picks up a small black lipstick tube, showing it to the lens while the woman looks on with a smile, occasionally adjusting her position. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting their facial features and the metallic texture of the product packages on the table. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the woman's face as she smiles broadly, showcasing her lip color; she then reaches into a maroon handbag and pulls out a pink lipstick tube. The man observes her actions, his hands moving expressively as he continues to engage with her. (4) The scene transitions to a series of product close-ups: a hand applies a swatch of brownish-nude lipstick onto a wrist, followed by a clear view of a MAC lipstick tube. The man's tattooed forearm is visible in these shots as he demonstrates the product application. (5) Returning to the medium shot, the man and woman continue their interaction; the man points to his own lips while the woman gestures with her hands as she speaks. The background remains the same textured wall, and the glass table with samples remains the center of the frame. (6) In the final phase, the woman holds up both the pink and black lipstick tubes towards the camera, smiling warmly. They both wave toward the lens as the man gestures for a goodbye, and the video concludes with a quick shot of the woman posing with the products before fading to black.

(3) The male speaker resumes his enthusiastic narration, his pitch variability high as he praises the guest's style; the BGM remains a constant, light-hearted background layer. (4) A subtle 'sparkle' or 'magic' sound effect marks a transition as the dialogue shifts focus to specific makeup products. (5) The female voice takes over a larger share of the audio, speaking at a moderate pace with a calm yet positive valence, explaining her choice of lip colors; a short, airy 'whoosh' SFX is heard during a visual cut to a close-up. (6) The interview continues with a rhythmic interplay between the two voices over the continuous, loopable BGM; the male asks questions with a rising intonation while the female responds with a confident, level contour. (7) The video concludes with both speakers laughing and saying 'Bye bye' simultaneously, followed by a final swell of the upbeat music as it fades out alongside the last few spoken words.
